strengths_deep_dive: While financial efficiency remains a severe limiting factor, Afghan Refugee Relief provides direct tangible support to displaced families. In FY2024, the organization distributed <cite id="2">$85,000 in financial aid</cite> alongside practical technology and furniture distributions [2]. Their program services helped settle newly arrived refugees by supplying <cite id="2">1,700 phones and 750 laptops</cite> to facilitate connectivity and remote support [2].
rich_narrative.summary: Afghan Refugee Relief provides direct aid to families but spends a low percentage of its budget on program services. In FY2024, the organization reported <cite id="5">total revenue of $205,225</cite> to support its community-focused mission [5]. Primary operational limiting factors restrict its effectiveness, notably a <cite id="1">program expense ratio of 28.9%</cite> in FY2024, which falls significantly below the <cite id="1">75% industry standard</cite> and the <cite id="1">88.9% peer program ratio median</cite> [1]. Despite these heavy overhead costs, the group delivered direct assistance, including <cite id="2">$85,000 in financial aid distributed</cite> and <cite id="2">200 homes furnished</cite> [2]. They also provided essential supplies by distributing <cite id="2">750 laptops</cite> and collecting <cite id="2">1,700 phones</cite> for arriving refugees [2]. Operationally, the group maintains a lean buffer with <cite id="1">1.3 months of working capital</cite> [1]. While community members can contribute through <cite id="4">volunteer opportunities</cite> or <cite id="3">sadaqah donations</cite>, the vast majority of financial contributions go toward non-program expenses [3][4].
